title: Service credits and concessions: revenue and billing impact
prompt: Review contractual service credits and concessions to determine their potential impact on revenue recognition and billing.

inputs.name: Invoices, credit memos and the revenue recognition schedule for the customer
Customer contract with the service level and credit terms
Correspondence granting or discussing the credits

steps: read the contract's service level and credit terms, the correspondence and the revised billing schedule; list each credit or concession with its date, amount and basis
classify each as contractual (a service credit under the SLA), a price concession or a contract modification, citing the paragraphs relied on and marking each "verify"
set out the effect on variable consideration, the transaction price and the recognition pattern under each alternative; list the missing facts
compare with the invoices and credit memos already issued in Dime
write the memo and the workbook of credits, billed amounts and differences

done.text: The memo cites the paragraphs it relies on, marks every citation "verify", draws no conclusion where facts are missing, and leaves the judgement with the accountant; it uses none of the words definitely, certainly or guaranteed
The memo exists as a pdf
Every exception row (a credit not yet billed, a concession without documentation) cites the contract clause, the correspondence item or the invoice id
service-credits.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
